labels.PASS: gate checked within declared scope only
labels.UNRESOLVED: claim cannot be certified from present model

gates.name: Source and dimension audit
gates.minimum: Source manifest provenance, consistent dimensions, documented constitutive assumptions

gates.name: Constrained Euler-director variation
gates.minimum: Piola F-gradient and director Q-gradient independently checked with finite differences; correct Euler limit

gates.name: Free transverse Maxwell-form limit
gates.minimum: Faraday/Ampere source-free identities, two transverse modes, calibrated energy and second-order test-wave time convergence

gates.name: Gyroscopic magnetooptical physical closure
gates.minimum: Independent derivation of Omega(B) and quantified limits against physical observations; not a laboratory Coriolis artifact

gates.name: Full 3D coupled solver dynamics
gates.minimum: 3D X,q integration, detF-1, div q, energy, spatial and temporal convergence, periodic and nonperiodic parity

gates.name: PKLSA source-native fidelity
gates.minimum: Actual knot seed with manifest SHA, circulation, core, convergence and independent geometry-family holdout

gates.name: Physical interaction claims
gates.minimum: Predictions of charge-current, gravity, particle spectra, clock, quantum photon observables not baked in
